payload.goal: Find MOFs that bind CO2 strongly in humid air (CO2 must out-bind water).

The campaign ran for one round and consumed the full DFT budget. In round one we bought 40 DFT lookups and spent 40 of 40 of the allowed budget [c0010]. The purchase returned one new hit and the total hit count remains 1 hits total [c0010].

The only hit identified in this round is m8d5ba73 [c0010]. For that structure the DFT label shows E_CO2 -0.593, E_H2O -0.389 and S -0.593 with hit true [c0010]. The remaining bought structures are non-hits, for example m6f74a91 with E_CO2 -0.558, E_H2O -0.932 and S -0.085 [c0010], m71fbe21 with E_CO2 -0.502, E_H2O -0.76 and S -0.145 [c0010], and m8ae2906 with E_CO2 -0.491, E_H2O -0.69 and S -0.191 [c0010].

With the DFT budget exhausted at 40 spent [c0010] no further DFT evaluations can be performed in this campaign. The single hit provides a validated example of CO2 out-binding water under the DFT criteria, and the set of 40 labelled structures offers a limited empirical check of the cheap simulator’s ranking. No additional MOFs can be tested until budget is replenished.
